facts.claim: You can connect a VPC to a corporate data center with an IPsec AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection, which consists of two VPN tunnels between a virtual private gateway or transit gateway on the AWS side and a customer gateway device on your side.
facts.quote: You can optionally connect your VPC to your own corporate data center using an IPsec AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection, making the AWS Cloud an extension of your data center.

facts.claim: A resource control policy (RCP) centrally sets the maximum available permissions on the AWS resources in your organization, for example to allow access only by identities that belong to your organization.
facts.quote: Using RCPs, you can centrally set the maximum available permissions to your AWS resources as you scale your workloads on AWS. For example, an RCP can help restrict access to your resources so that they can only be accessed by identities that belong to your organization, or specifying the conditions under which identities external to your organization can access your resources.

facts.claim: AWS customers get 100 GB of data transfer out to the internet free each month, aggregated across all AWS services and Regions except China and GovCloud.
facts.quote: AWS customers receive 100 GB of free data transfer out to the internet free each month, aggregated across all AWS Services and Regions (except China and GovCloud).

facts.claim: An account can store 20 server certificates in IAM by default, and the maximum quota in the IAM guide table is also 20.
facts.quote: | Server certificates per account | 20 | 20 |

facts.claim: An instance profile name can be at most 128 characters.
facts.quote: | Instance profile name | 128 characters |

facts.claim: The SAA exam is focused on the design of cost and performance optimized solutions and does not require deep hands-on coding experience, although familiarity with basic programming concepts is an advantage.
facts.quote: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate is focused on the design of cost and performance optimized solutions. This is an ideal starting point for candidates with AWS Cloud or strong on-premises IT experience. This exam does not require deep hands-on coding experience, although familiarity with basic programming concepts would be an advantage.

facts.claim: The exam guide's resilient-architectures domain asks for determining the AWS services required to provide a highly available and/or fault-tolerant architecture across AWS Regions or Availability Zones, and for identifying metrics based on business requirements to deliver a highly available solution.
facts.quote: Determining the AWS services required to provide a highly available and/or fault-tolerant architecture across AWS Regions or Availability Zones

facts.claim: A role's trust policy is the only resource-based policy type in IAM; its Principal element names who can assume the role, and the principals can be accounts, users, roles, federated users and services.
facts.quote: The IAM resource-based policy type is a role trust policy. In IAM roles, use the `Principal` element in the role trust policy to specify who can assume the role.

facts.claim: Reaching an AWS service's public endpoint in the same Region through an internet gateway has no data transfer charge, while reaching it through a NAT gateway adds a per-gigabyte data processing charge.
facts.quote: If the internet gateway is used to access the public endpoint of the AWS services in the same Region (Figure 1 – Pattern 1), there are no data transfer charges. If a NAT gateway is used to access the same services (Figure 1 – Pattern 2), there is a data processing charge (per gigabyte (GB)) for data that passes through the gateway.

facts.claim: The exam guide asks for designing a role-based access control strategy with AWS STS, role switching and cross-account access, and for determining when to federate a directory service with IAM roles.
facts.quote: Designing a role-based access control strategy (for example, AWS STS, role switching, cross-account access)

facts.claim: Customer-managed prefix lists are IP ranges that you define, manage and can share with other accounts; AWS-managed prefix lists are IP ranges of AWS services that you cannot create, modify, share or delete.
facts.quote: You can share your prefix list with other AWS accounts, enabling those accounts to reference the prefix list in their own resources.

facts.claim: A beta exam contains more total questions and more scored questions than the standard version of the same exam, and AWS uses beta exams to validate the performance of questions before they are used on standard exams.
facts.quote: A beta exam contains more total questions and more scored questions than the standard version of the same exam.

facts.claim: The default quota is 5 internet gateways per Region; to raise it, raise the quota for VPCs per Region. Only one internet gateway can be attached to a VPC at a time.
facts.quote: |  Internet gateways per Region  |  5  | [Yes](https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home/services/vpc/quotas/L-A4707A72) | To increase this quota, increase the quota for VPCs per Region. You can attach only one internet gateway to a VPC at a time. |

facts.claim: Participants cannot launch instances with the default security group of a shared VPC, because it belongs to the owner.
facts.quote: Participants can't launch instances using the default security group for the VPC because it belongs to the owner.

facts.claim: If resources in several Availability Zones share one NAT gateway and that gateway's Availability Zone goes down, resources in the other Availability Zones lose internet access; create a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone and route each zone to its own gateway.
facts.quote: If you have resources in multiple Availability Zones and they share one NAT gateway, and if the NAT gateway's Availability Zone is down, resources in the other Availability Zones lose internet access. To improve resiliency, create a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone, and configure your routing to ensure that resources use the NAT gateway in the same Availability Zone.

facts.claim: An RCP limits the principals that access a resource in a member account with an applicable RCP, whether or not the principal belongs to the organization, including root users; the exception is service-linked roles, because RCPs do not apply to calls made by service-linked roles. Use an RCP to restrict external principals and an SCP to limit your own principals.
facts.quote: RCPs impact the effective permissions of principals trying to access resources in a member account with an applicable RCP, regardless of whether the principals belong to the same organizations or not. This includes root users. The exception is when principals are service-linked roles because RCPs do not apply to calls made by service-linked roles.

facts.claim: The credential report includes only passwords, the first two access keys per user, MFA devices and X.509 signing certificates; it does not include service-specific credentials.
facts.quote: The IAM credential report only includes the following IAM-managed credentials: passwords, the first two access keys per user, MFA devices, and X.509 signing certificates.

facts.claim: Traffic between a NAT gateway and an EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone over private IP addresses has no data transfer charge; if they are in different Availability Zones, data transfer charges apply.
facts.quote: There was also no charge for the data transfer between the NAT gateway and the EC2 instance since the traffic stays in the same Availability Zone using private IP addresses. There will be data transfer charges between your NAT gateway and EC2 instance if they are in a different Availability Zone.

facts.claim: The instance only knows its private IP address; the internet gateway performs one-to-one NAT so outbound traffic carries the instance's public IPv4 or Elastic IP address and inbound traffic to that public address is translated to the private address.
facts.quote: Your instance is only aware of the private (internal) IP address space defined within the VPC and subnet. The internet gateway logically provides the one-to-one NAT on behalf of your instance, so that when traffic leaves your VPC subnet and goes to the internet, the reply address field is set to the public IPv4 address or Elastic IP address of your instance, and not its private IP address.

facts.claim: Elastic IP addresses are regional: an Elastic IP address belongs to one Region.
facts.quote: Elastic IP addresses are regional.
